brief.headline: Push our laminate price from ₹385.00/KG down to ₹250.00/KG — that's what we pay Silk Polypack and it sits at the top of the fair market band (₹205–305/kg).

priceAsk.summary: Cut the laminate price from ₹385.00/KG to ₹250.00/KG
priceAsk.basis: We already pay Silk Polypack ₹250.00/KG for the same laminate — that's a 54.0% gap. The market ask for pharma/ORS sachet laminate is ₹205–305/kg (typical ₹250/kg), so our target sits at the top of the fair band. Closing this gap saves us ₹22718 a year.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 60 days to 30 days after receipt
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Frees up ₹5325 of cash for us

brief.financialLeverage: UFLEX is a giant — ₹16492.00 Cr in sales — so our ₹64788 is invisible (0.00% of their business). They're growing fast (35.5% a year) and need new orders to fill capacity, which helps us. They owe 1.25 times their own cash (₹10152.31 Cr total debt), so cash matters to them — offer faster payment in return for the price cut. Their profit is decent (they keep ₹4.10 of every ₹100 they sell), but the debt load means they'll value a reliable, quick-paying customer.

evidence.point: We pay UFLEX ₹385.00/KG but Silk Polypack charges us ₹250.00/KG for the same laminate
Market asking price for pharma/ORS sachet laminate is ₹205–305/kg, typical ₹250/kg — our target is market-fair
Closing the price gap saves us this much each year
They're growing sales fast and want volume
They owe a lot relative to their own cash
We're too small to matter on our own

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexible-packaging converter, already a tiny FDC supplier — a proven, scalable second source for laminate sachets (revenue ₹2755.75 Cr, health C 58/100)

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Part of the global Constantia group, makes pharma blister and sachet laminates in India — strong second-source option (revenue ₹222.04 Cr, health D 31/100)

alternates.name: Amcor Flexibles India Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Indian arm of global Amcor — high-end pharma laminates, premium but very reliable (no public financials)

risks: We're 0.00% of their sales, so we have almost no pull on our own — bundle more volume, commit longer, or play them against Silk Polypack and the other converters to get traction.
Their debt is high (1.25x) — watch for any supply hiccups, though they're big enough and profitable enough (4.1% margin) that the risk is small.
If we push too hard they may walk — they don't need our tiny order. Lead with the volume commitment (tie it to their 35.5% growth story) and the faster payment, then ask for the price cut.
Paying 30 days instead of 60 frees up ₹5325 for us, but only offer it in exchange for the full price cut to ₹250.00/KG — don't give it away for nothing.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We want to grow our laminate volume with you, but right now we're paying ₹385 when the same material costs us ₹250 elsewhere and the market sits at ₹205–305 — let's talk about closing that gap and how we can pay you faster in return.
